declared_purpose: Generate speech, sound effects and music, list/create voices, and check subscription quota and usage through ElevenLabs. Supporting source adds multi-speaker dialogue generation and optional speaker splitting. API authentication is required; local metadata, playback and credential persistence are conditional choices (SKILL.md:2-3,17-19,68-154; scripts/dialogs.py:2-23).

data_operations.data_scope: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: User shell profile; optionally a skill-folder or state-directory .env file
data_operations.condition: Only if the user follows these instructions. Packaged scripts use arguments/environment for authentication; the documented .env loading is not implemented.

data_operations.data_scope: Copies of audio sample files
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.openclaw/elevenlabs/voiceclone-samples/
data_operations.condition: Setup recommends copying samples here; --sample-dir offers an alternative. This is an instruction, not an automatic script copy.

data_operations.operation: Documented state storage with unresolved implementation mismatch
data_operations.source: Setup documentation and quota state-directory helpers
data_operations.data_scope: Credential configuration, cached quota/usage data and sample-directory locations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Documented state directory; quota helper additionally considers workspace and legacy directories
data_operations.condition: SETUP.md describes automatic state creation and possible caches. quota.py defines directory-discovery helpers but its supplied execution paths do not call them or implement configuration loading/caching.

data_operations.data_scope: Raw text, voice ID, model, voice settings, optional output format and API credential; returned audio and character cost
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}; response returned to the function caller
data_operations.condition: When generate_speech or its CLI is invoked with authentication. The module function does not itself save audio.

data_operations.data_scope: Prompt, influence, model, optional duration/loop, output format and API credential; returned audio
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/sound-generation
data_operations.condition: On generate_sfx invocation after credential and duration checks. Audio persistence follows within this function.

data_operations.data_scope: Entire selected UTF-8 file
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: music.py process memory
data_operations.condition: CLI composition-plan mode; this read is not restricted by the output-path guard.

data_operations.source: compose_music arguments; CLI prompt or parsed composition-plan file
data_operations.data_scope: Prompt and optional duration, or entire parsed composition plan; model, instrumental setting, output format and API credential
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/music; returned audio stays with the function caller
data_operations.condition: Prompt takes precedence in the module function; otherwise a composition plan is required. CLI authentication comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

data_operations.data_scope: Entire parsed JSON value, including any extra fields inside list elements
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: dialogs.py process memory
data_operations.condition: The file must exist and the top-level value must be a list. Element schemas are not validated.

data_operations.source: generate_dialogue arguments or CLI-loaded input list
data_operations.data_scope: Entire inputs list, model, normalization setting, optional stability/language/seed, output format and API credential
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-dialogue; audio and character cost returned to caller
data_operations.condition: When invoked with authentication. The implementation returns empty voice segments and null alignments rather than timestamps.

data_operations.data_scope: Generated speech, sound effects, music or combined dialogue audio
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Caller-selected output file under the output guard's allowed roots
data_operations.condition: Speech, music and dialogue CLIs require output paths; generate_sfx writes within the function itself. Parent directories are created. These path checks occur after generation requests.

data_operations.source: Original dialogue inputs, CLI settings and DialogueResult
data_operations.data_scope: Full inputs including text and extra fields, model/format/normalization, voice segments and alignments
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: --metadata JSON file under allowed output roots
data_operations.condition: Only when --metadata is supplied. With the supplied generator, segments are empty and alignments null; the full input remains stored.

data_operations.operation: Resolve and open selected cloning samples locally
data_operations.data_scope: Selected audio files, paths, extensions and sizes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: voiceclone.py process and open file handles
data_operations.condition: Paths must resolve within the selected sample directory; extensions are allowlisted and each file is limited to 50 MB. The directory is created if absent. Handles are closed; samples are not deleted by this path.

data_operations.operation: Upload samples and request creation of a remote voice
data_operations.source: clone_voice arguments, selected sample handles and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY fallback
data_operations.data_scope: Audio contents, sample basenames/MIME types, voice name, optional description/labels, noise-removal setting and API credential
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices/add; response returned to caller
data_operations.condition: After sample validation. Each resolved sample is added once to the final upload list. Language/accent/gender/age labels are caller-supplied, not inferred by this code. CLI prints name, voice ID and verification status, or raw response with --json.

data_operations.data_scope: API credential; returned voice records, including names, IDs, categories and labels
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices; stdout to caller
data_operations.condition: On voices.py invocation. Default output displays selected fields and all returned labels; --json explicitly returns the full response. No local attribute inference or file persistence is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve subscription data and derive quota indicators
data_operations.source: get_subscription argument/environment credential and API response
data_operations.data_scope: API credential; subscription/quota fields; calculated percentage, reset date, days remaining and warning status
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user/subscription; function caller or CLI stdout
data_operations.condition: Every quota CLI invocation fetches subscription data. --json prints the full subscription response; normal output derives and displays quota/plan/voice-capacity indicators. No cache write is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve usage history and calculate usage summaries
data_operations.source: get_usage_stats parameters, credential and API response
data_operations.data_scope: API credential, time range, breakdown and aggregation settings; returned time series and breakdown keys; calculated totals
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/usage/character-stats; function caller or CLI stdout
data_operations.condition: CLI fetches this only with --usage, for --days or 30 days by default, grouped by voice/day. Module callers may select user, API-key or product breakdowns. --json returns raw data; normal output sums breakdowns and displays recent daily totals.

data_operations.source: Sound prompt, generation arguments and output path
data_operations.data_scope: First 60 prompt characters, duration/loop/influence, saved path and audio size
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: stdout to caller
data_operations.condition: generate_sfx prints progress by default. No additional recipient or persistent logging destination is established by the supplied source.

data_operations.data_scope: Audio file and its local path
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local afplay subprocess and audio output
data_operations.condition: Only the sfx CLI --play branch invokes playback. Source does not implement network playback or AirPlay transmission.

data_operations.operation: Inspect local directory context and restrict output paths
data_operations.source: PWD, TMPDIR, current directory, script location and requested output path
data_operations.data_scope: Local paths, directory-existence checks and resolved output locations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local _pathguard process state; cached allowed-root list
data_operations.condition: When safe_output_path is called. Allowed roots are the discovered workspace, /tmp and resolved TMPDIR. No file contents or paths are transmitted by this helper.

data_operations.operation: Conditionally split audio into local speaker clips
data_operations.source: Combined audio and supplied VoiceSegment objects
data_operations.data_scope: Audio intervals, voice IDs and clip paths containing voice-ID prefixes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ffmpeg subprocess and output_dir clip files
data_operations.condition: Direct split_by_speakers callers with nonempty segments invoke ffmpeg. The packaged dialogue generator returns no segments, so its normal --split-speakers CLI path only creates the directory. The helper itself does not apply an output guard.

data_operations.operation: Propagate API error details to callers and CLI error output
data_operations.data_scope: Response status and response text or extracted detail; exact returned contents unknown
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Raised exceptions to module callers; stderr in CLI handlers
data_operations.condition: On applicable API failures. This establishes caller-visible error output, not transmission to an additional service.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unexpected fields accompanying dialogue text/voice-ID pairs
potential_excess.condition: A CLI list element or module caller supplies extra fields. Only the CLI top-level list type is checked; the complete inputs value is forwarded.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The documented dialogue input is a list of text/voice-ID pairs.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Send the requested dialogue text and voice assignments for synthesis.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Validate each element and construct an allowlisted text/voice_id payload. This narrows data in the required request rather than eliminating generation.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve ordering and documented fields; explicitly support any additional generation fields before allowing them.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full dialogue transcript and arbitrary additional input fields
potential_excess.condition: The user requests metadata; inputs are included automatically.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: --metadata is described as output for voice segments and alignment data.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Persist requested segment/alignment information and settings needed to interpret it.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit full inputs by default; provide a separate transcript opt-in or retain only necessary input indexes/voice mappings. Keep the metadata write itself.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve segment relationships and explicitly requested transcript exports. The current generator supplies empty segments and null alignments.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Multipart filename fields sent to ElevenLabs POST /v1/voices/add
potential_excess.condition: Every selected cloning sample is uploaded with path.name, potentially exposing names or contextual identifiers in filenames.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Voice cloning requires sample audio; preserving the user's original basename is an implementation choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Upload selected audio samples with compatible multipart structure and media types.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use neutral sequential upload filenames while retaining required extensions/MIME types. This removes extra metadata from the required upload.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Confirm that the external API accepts neutral filenames; filename-specific validation is not documented in the supplied source.

potential_excess.data_scope: An additional complete copy of each cloning sample
potential_excess.condition: The user follows the documented cp workflow while retaining originals. The script does not perform this copy automatically.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Samples must be readable within a controlled sample directory; a second persistent copy is not required when a suitable existing directory can be selected.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Read and upload the explicitly selected samples while enforcing directory containment.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use --sample-dir with an existing controlled sample directory where appropriate, avoiding the redundant local copy. Keep the required sample read/upload.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve path containment, extension/size validation and access to all intended samples; do not broaden the sample root unnecessarily.

unknowns: ElevenLabs server implementations are absent. Retention, logging, training use, subprocessors, inferred voice attributes and deletion of submitted text/audio or created voices remain unresolved.
The API's required multipart filename semantics are not supplied; neutral-filename compatibility remains unresolved.
External response schemas and error contents are unspecified. Raw JSON and error outputs cannot be exhaustively classified beyond fields accessed by the packaged code.

SETUP.md describes .env loading, automatic state creation and possible quota caches, while packaged execution paths do not implement those behaviors. Any external implementation is outside the supplied evidence.
No packaged operation deletes generated files, metadata, sample copies or remote voices. External cleanup, filesystem backups, stdout capture and retention are unknown.

The supplied dialogue response path provides no timestamps or speaker segments. Whether the external API can provide them through another mode is unresolved; the packaged CLI cannot currently produce speaker clips from its own generation result.
